measures.what: outer diameter of the circuit board
measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: the two small mounting holes near the centre: distance between hole centres, hole diameter, and where the line joining them points (relative to the connector/wire side, +y)
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: board thickness, and how far the connector and any components stick out from the back face, plus the connector's position (distance from centre and width)
measures.reply: led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: I can't measure that; led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: length and width of the board, board thickness, and the hole diameter plus hole centre spacing along the length and along the width
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: total height above the board's top face (tallest part), how far parts/solder joints stick out below the board, and where the USB-C port is: distance from board centre along the long side, how far the port mouth sticks past or sits inside the board edge, and height of the port centre above the board top face
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 position: in female headers on the perfboard's columns 8 and 18, rows 2 to 23; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.what: the plug's overmold/housing width, height (thickness) and length that sticks out where it enters the ESP32 port
measures.reply: esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 position: in female headers on the perfboard's columns 8 and 18, rows 2 to 23; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.what: outer diameter, measured across the full width with a ruler or tape (or edge-to-edge across the widest span; if you only have calipers, measure a chord and tell me how)
measures.reply: led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm; led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: distance from the perfboard's edge nearest the USB-C port to the outside of the port mouth (is the mouth beyond the board edge or inside it?), and distance from the perfboard's long edge to the port's centreline
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.what: how far the solder joints / pin tails / screw terminals / capacitor stick out beyond the underside, and the height of the screw terminals and capacitor above the top face; also corner hole centre spacing
measures.reply: perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge

measures.what: stack height of the 4-pin connector on the back (how far it sticks out of the back face, with wires plugged in and where the wires exit), and the LED disc board thickness by stacking against a known item if possible
measures.reply: led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: distance from the disc's outer edge to the nearest edge of the hole on the same side (edge of disc to the hole edge closer to that edge)
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm

measures.what: where the input wire connector/solder pads are on the back: distance from disc centre to the nearest and farthest end of the connector along the 12 o'clock direction, its width, and how tall it stands off the back face
measures.reply: led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: with the ESP32 USB-C port at the end: distance from the perfboard's nearer long edge to the nearest edge of the USB-C port opening, and the port opening's width and height
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.what: height of the tallest thing on the perfboard other than the ESP32 (screw terminals, capacitor) above the board's top face, and the length solder tails stick out under the board

measures.item: USB-C plug on the wall charger
measures.what: width and thickness of the plug's moulded housing (the widest part that must pass through a hole in the box), and the housing length
measures.reply: I can't measure that. Use your best judgment.

measures.item: the two wall screws you'll hang the box on
measures.what: head diameter, head height, shank (thread outer) diameter
measures.reply: wall screws size: #8 round-head screws in 1/4 inch anchors; I bought ones with heads 9 mm across at most
